newsitem.title: USA: NYSE, Amex open on time.
newsitem.headline: NYSE, Amex open on time.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange and the American Stock Exchange opened on time and said they were not affected by a power surge that struck the downtown Manhattan area on Wednesday morning.
Nasdaq said it was also operating normally. All of the exchanges began trading at 0930 EDT/1430 GMT.

At least one brokerage firm, Morgan Stanley Group Inc, experienced a surge at its midtown Manhattan offices, which caused its computer system to cease operating, according to an associate analyst at Morgan.
